hook_formulas: Named method in ALL CAPS: 'THE LOVE LETTER METHOD', 'THEY NEED ME METHOD', 'I AM SIMPLY DECIDING METHOD!!!', 'this is the "I am sure" method'
High-desire outcome promise, often with a speed claim: 'manifest anyone OVERNIGHT', 'manifest a text instantly', 'get them obsessed!!!!', 'HOW I MANIFESTED A TEXT IN ONE MINUTE'
Save-bait instruction: 'repeat these affirmations for 7 days or listen three times' / 'repeat for 21 days'
Destiny/second-person address: 'The one you see is the one you're meant to hear'
Single-line mantra as hook: 'I get paid to exist'
Reply-to-comment ('Replying to @...') for follow-ups and clapbacks

Stella era: outcome + app in one line ('get your custom visualization audio of them obsessed w you on Stella!!!'); disbelief testimonial ('wdym i've been manifesting for YEARS & NOW i'm finding this??')
patterns.persona_voice: Gen-Z 'hot girl' high priestess / big-sister mystic turned founder; lowercase casual captions mixed with ALL-CAPS excitement and stacked exclamation marks; emojis 🧿🤍💗✨; unapologetically 'delusional' (podcast 'The Most Delusional People Always Win'); luxury/self-worth framing ('Start believing you're a luxury...'); spite and pain as fuel ('Peace and love doesn't build empires, pain does'); women-vs-men founder framing ('Women are going to dominate this app space, and men should prepare for that').
patterns.pacing_format: Mostly direct-to-camera talking head, fast method walk-throughs, affirmation lists read rapidly; text-on-screen headline; trending sounds on lighter posts; reply-to-comment videos; occasional skit interruption (a guy asking 'How can I remember all these?') used to insert the app naturally.
recurring_themes: Manifesting a specific person / getting them obsessed (largest likes: 1.6M)
Manifest a text / ex back / love letter method
Money affirmations ('I get paid to exist', 'My mind is worth millions', 'I don't work for money, money works for me')
Stella: future self, custom audio stories, dream-life visualization
Founder/revenue narrative (MRR, built with AI in days, women in apps, spite, haters boost the algorithm) - present mainly in interviews (Starter Story) rather than in indexed short-form captions
cta_patterns: Link in bio / 'at the top of my page' pinned product (Stan Store courses)
Comment keyword -> ManyChat DM (IG): comment 'download' -> custom affirmations + App Store link -> 'if you review the app, let me know so I can thank you personally'
Long version on YouTube ('PINNED AND ON MY YT FOR IN DEPTH')
Stella: 'download Stella to meet your future self', 'get your custom ... on Stella', 'you can actually get custom affirmations on your lock screen every single day using my app Stella'
Implicit save CTA via 'repeat for X days / listen 3x'
strategy_notes: Recreate proven virals 'to infinity' (e.g. re-posting 'manifest a text' in 2024 with 'if youre new here, this method was one of the first videos i had go viral')
Content first, product second: mine comments for 'I wish this existed'; Stella productizes a prior ChatGPT future-self prompt video
Insert the app into the existing top niche rather than making pure ads; demo videos that show the use case convert better than name-drops
Controversy/haters reframed as algorithm boost: 'My most successful videos are the most controversial ones'
Multiple accounts: main, a 700K 'spam post' account, and a new 2026 account (~40K) for Stella
patterns.gaps: Very few build-in-public/founder-story short-form videos by her own accounts were indexed publicly; founder narrative is documented mostly via Starter Story (YouTube/Threads) and press. Instagram reels mostly not indexed. No verified view counts; all metrics are search-snippet like/comment counts or self-reported.
